vb_textbox.text: The best advice i can give is just naturally go with your instincts. Most of the time that i have played this, i found out there isn't much point difference between the two choices. both at the same time can give high points and low/no points. Thought i think, the long mushroom dwarfs might give off a few more points, i just not fully sure when i was going through it. You just gotta keep track what dwarfs offers what and i think the colour of the basket might also come into play.
